top_signals.title: Nakilat Names Nine New Gas Carriers in South Korea
top_signals.summary: Qatar Gas Transport Company (Nakilat) has named nine new gas carriers at three South Korean shipyards, marking progress in its fleet expansion programs aimed at increasing LNG transportation capacity and diversifying into LPG/ammonia shipping.The naming ceremonies…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
